sentences.en: The museum's new exhibit is ______ with fascinating artifacts from ancient Egypt.
sentences.zh: 博物館的新展覽充滿了來自古埃及的迷人文物。

sentences.en: His speech was ______ with statistics and expert opinions.
sentences.zh: 他的演講中充滿了統計數據和專家意見。

sentences.en: The store staff worked to ______ the shelves before the holiday rush.
sentences.zh: 店員在假期人潮湧入前忙著補貨上架。

sentences.en: Drinking water regularly helps ______ the body's fluids after exercise.
sentences.zh: 運動後定時補充水分有助於恢復體內的水分。

sentences.en: The new employee was eager to be ______ with every company rule.
sentences.zh: 這位新員工急於順從公司的每一項規定。

sentences.en: The dog was surprisingly ______ during its first visit to the vet.
sentences.zh: 這隻狗在第一次看獸醫時出乎意料地十分順從。

sentences.en: Their skills are ______; she handles design while he manages finances.
sentences.zh: 他們的技能互補;她負責設計,而他負責財務管理。

sentences.en: The wine was chosen for its ______ flavor to the seafood dish.
sentences.zh: 這款葡萄酒的挑選是因為它與海鮮料理的風味相得益彰。

sentences.en: The soft music helped ______ the quiet, elegant atmosphere of the restaurant.
sentences.zh: 輕柔的音樂讓這間餐廳寧靜優雅的氛圍更加相得益彰。

sentences.en: Her calm personality ______s his more energetic nature perfectly.
sentences.zh: 她沉穩的個性與他較為活潑的性格相輔相成。

words.defn_en: an expression of esteem or approval:

sentences.en: She blushed at the unexpected ______ about her presentation.
sentences.zh: 聽到這句對她簡報意外的讚美,她臉紅了起來。

sentences.en: He accepted the ______ graciously, thanking his whole team.
sentences.zh: 他大方地接受了這句讚美,並感謝了他整個團隊。

words.defn_en: to use up the supply or resources of something:

sentences.en: The drought began to ______ the region's water reserves.
sentences.zh: 這場乾旱開始使該地區的水資源逐漸枯竭。

sentences.en: Overfishing has ______ d the local fish population.
sentences.zh: 過度捕撈已使當地魚群數量耗盡。

words.defn_en: reduced in quantity, especially to a critically low level:

sentences.en: Soldiers fought on with ______ ammunition.
sentences.zh: 士兵們在彈藥耗盡的情況下仍持續作戰。

sentences.en: The country's ______ oil reserves forced new energy policies.
sentences.zh: 這個國家枯竭的石油儲備迫使政府制定新的能源政策。

words.defn_en: to put a plan or decision into action; to carry out:

sentences.en: The company decided to ______ the new policy starting next month.
sentences.zh: 這家公司決定從下個月起實施這項新政策。

sentences.en: The business will ______ new rules to comply with the change in laws.
sentences.zh: 這家企業將實施新規定,以配合法律的變動。

words.defn_en: complete in every respect; fully attended:

sentences.en: The board was granted ______ authority to make the decision.
sentences.zh: 董事會被授予完全的決策權力。

sentences.en: All delegates gathered for the conference's opening ______ session.
sentences.zh: 所有代表齊聚一堂,參加這場研討會開幕的全體大會。

sentences.en: The harvest festival celebrated the ______ of the autumn crops.
sentences.zh: 這場豐收節慶祝著秋季作物的豐盛。

sentences.en: He spoke with the wisdom that comes from a ______ of life experience.
sentences.zh: 他說話帶著源自豐富人生閱歷的智慧。

words.root_note: plentee (abundance), from Old French, from Latin plenus (full)

sentences.en: The harvest this year was unusually ______ .
sentences.zh: 今年的收成異常豐富。

sentences.en: Fresh fish are ______ along this stretch of coastline.
sentences.zh: 沿著這段海岸線,新鮮的魚類十分豐富。

words.defn_en: an abundance or ample quantity of something:
words.root_note: plenus (full), from Latin, variant of plenitude

sentences.en: The market offered a ______ of fresh seasonal produce.
sentences.zh: 這座市場提供了豐富的當季新鮮農產品。

sentences.en: Their garden yielded a ______ of vegetables every summer.
sentences.zh: 他們的花園每年夏天都會產出大量的蔬菜。

words.root_note: plente (abundance), from Old French, from Latin plenus (full)

sentences.en: There was ______ of food left after the celebration.
sentences.zh: 這場慶祝活動結束後還剩下大量的食物。

sentences.en: He had ______ of time to prepare for the interview.
sentences.zh: 他有充足的時間為這場面試做準備。

words.defn_en: having a complex, interwoven structure like a network:
words.root_note: plexus (braid, network), from Latin plectere (to braid) + forma (shape)

sentences.en: The nerve tissue displayed a dense, ______ arrangement under the microscope.
sentences.zh: 在顯微鏡下,這片神經組織呈現出濃密的網狀排列。

sentences.en: Engineers designed a ______ support system for the bridge's cables.
sentences.zh: 工程師為這座橋的纜線設計了一套網狀的支撐系統。

words.defn_en: a network of nerves or vessels in the body:
words.root_note: plexus (braid, network), from Latin plectere (to braid)

sentences.en: A blow to the solar ______ can momentarily knock the wind out of someone.
sentences.zh: 太陽神經叢受到一擊可能會讓人一時喘不過氣。

sentences.en: The surgeon carefully avoided damaging the nerve ______ during the operation.
sentences.zh: 這位外科醫生在手術過程中小心翼翼地避免損傷這條神經叢。

words.defn_en: to add something extra to complete or enhance something else:

sentences.en: She decided to ______ her diet with vitamins to boost her energy levels.
sentences.zh: 她決定在飲食中補充維他命,以提升自己的體力。

sentences.en: She ______ her income by starting a side hustle.
sentences.zh: 她透過經營副業來補充自己的收入。
